title: Brand descriptor
description: Descriptor consumed by scripts/brand/descriptor.mjs (loadDescriptor) to drive the brand generator.

slug.description: Brand slug; must match the file name brands/<slug>.json.

displayName.description: Human-facing brand name. Defaults to slug.toUpperCase().

wordmark.description: Intro splash wordmark. Defaults to "${displayName} AGENT".

tagline.description: Short tagline. Defaults to a templated sentence using displayName.

appId.description: Desktop app bundle id. Defaults to "io.cmetech.${slug}".

scheme.description: Deep-link URL scheme. Defaults to slug.

homeDir.description: Per-brand home directory name (Plan 2 target; recorded but not consumed by Plan 1). Defaults to ".${slug}".

releasesRepo.description: GitHub "owner/repo" for release distribution. Defaults to "cmetech/${slug}".

updateCommand.description: Update command shown to users. Defaults to "${slug} update".

theme.description: Desktop theme/skin family to use. Defaults to "otto".

gateway.description: Model gateway provider slug. Defaults to "otto".

curation.description: Skill/tool curation overrides for this brand.

capabilitySets.description: Named capability sets enabled for this brand.

capabilitySources.description: Map of capability-set name -> public git URL the staging seam clones/pulls at startup (P2).

capabilityRequiresEnv.description: Per-set env gate checked BEFORE any network resolution — set name -> {ENV_VAR: required value}

personaSets.description: Named persona sets enabled for this brand.
